# Lelam

> Lelam is an Indian marketplace for curated pre-loved fashion, with private offers and daily live auctions.

"Lelam" means auction in Malayalam. Lelam connects buyers and sellers across India to trade pre-owned clothing, vintage pieces, streetwear, and designer thrift. Every listing is one of a kind, and every order includes tracked doorstep delivery and escrow-protected payment.

## Shop

- [Browse all listings](https://www.lelam.co/products): Filter curated pre-loved clothing, accessories, and vintage pieces by category, size, and condition.
- [Live and upcoming auctions](https://www.lelam.co/auctions): Timed daily auctions with anonymous bidding and anti-sniping protection.
- [Sell an item](https://www.lelam.co/sell): List a piece for a fixed price, private offers, or auction.
- [Sign in](https://www.lelam.co/login): Access saved items, offers, orders, and seller tools.
- [Create an account](https://www.lelam.co/register): Register as a buyer or seller.

## How buying works

- **Buy now**: Purchase instantly at the listed asking price.
- **Private offers**: Send a confidential price offer to the seller, who can accept, decline, or counter without public haggling.
- **Daily live auctions**: Bidding is anonymous and uses pseudonyms. A bid in the final 30 seconds extends the clock by 30 seconds. Winning bids are binding and payment is due within 10 minutes.
- **Escrow and inspection**: Payments are held until doorstep delivery and a 3-day inspection window closes. Buyers receive a refund if an item arrives damaged, counterfeit, or materially not as described.

## Pricing and fees

- **Buyers** pay the item price, delivery, and a flat ₹10 platform fee plus 18% GST (₹11.80 total). UPI, cards, netbanking, and cash on delivery are supported.
- **Sellers** pay a flat 10% commission on the final selling price, inclusive of GST, and keep 90%. Doorstep courier pickup is free across India.
